BUCK.description: Buckling Analysis Control (BUCK). A single control record (fixed key 1) holding the eigenvalue buckling settings plus a list of load cases (ITEMS) each referencing a static load case by name.

MODE_NUM.description: Number of buckling modes to extract.

OPT_POSITIVE.description: Load factor range type. true = positive value only; false = search within the LOAD_FACTOR_FROM/LOAD_FACTOR_TO range.

OPT_CONSIDER_AXIAL_ONLY.description: Frame geometric stiffness option: consider axial force component only.

LOAD_FACTOR_FROM.description: Search range lower bound for the load factor (applies when OPT_POSITIVE is false).

LOAD_FACTOR_TO.description: Search range upper bound for the load factor (applies when OPT_POSITIVE is false).

ITEMS.description: Load cases contributing to the buckling analysis. Only the first 15 entries are stored; each LCNAME must resolve to an existing static load case (otherwise the request fails).

LCNAME.description: Static load case name; must match an existing load case.

FACTOR.description: Scale factor applied to this load case.

LOAD_TYPE.description: Load type code for this load case (Variable/Constant classification).
